triggers.name: account_created
triggers.title: Account created
triggers.help: Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: Earliest created date, defaults to 1 day before recipe first starts. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be changed. Learn more

output.name: donorRecognitionName
output.label: Donor recognition name
output.hint: Required if type is 'Use Transaction Recognition Name'

output.name: initials
output.label: Initials
output.hint: Permitted only if name format is set to individual

output.name: suffix
output.label: Suffix
output.hint: Permitted only if name format is set to individual
